project_type: FastAPI backend with Celery workers, PostgreSQL database, Redis message broker
build_system: Python with pyproject.toml, Docker Compose for orchestration
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio for async tests, pytest-cov for coverage
verification_instructions: 1. Run docker-compose up -d to start services. 2. Run pytest to execute all tests. 3. Use curl or Postman to test API endpoints at http://localhost:8000. 4. Check /docs for Swagger UI. 5. Verify certificates are generated in data/certificates/ directory.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Alembic migrations in alembic/versions/ generated by 'alembic revision --autogenerate'. PDFs in data/certificates/<job_id>/<cert_id>.pdf generated at runtime.
environment_constraints: Requires Docker and Docker Compose. Services must start in order: PostgreSQL, Redis, then API and Worker. Worker must share volume with API for certificate file access. Database migrations must run before API starts.
contribution_requirements: Follow Python PEP 8 style. Use type hints throughout. All public functions need docstrings. Pydantic for validation. SQLAlchemy 2.x syntax. Async/await for database operations. Environment variables via Pydantic Settings. No hardcoded credentials.
key_patterns: FastAPI dependency injection for database sessions. Pydantic V2 schemas with Field validators. SQLAlchemy 2.x models with relationship() and Mapped types. Celery tasks with bind=True and retry logic. ReportLab canvas for PDF generation with A4 landscape format. Service layer pattern separating business logic from API routes. Repository pattern for database queries.
relevant_files: app/main.py - FastAPI application entry point with CORS and routes
app/core/config.py - Pydantic Settings for env vars
app/core/database.py - SQLAlchemy engine, session factory, dependency
app/services/file_manager.py - File path and storage management
app/tasks/generate.py - Celery task for certificate generation
tests/conftest.py - pytest fixtures for DB, client, sample data
docker-compose.yml - PostgreSQL, Redis, API, Worker services
Dockerfile - Multi-stage build for API and Worker
directory_structure: app/ contains all application code split by concern: api/ for routes, core/ for config/db/celery, models/ for SQLAlchemy, schemas/ for Pydantic, services/ for business logic, tasks/ for Celery, templates/ for PDF design. tests/ mirrors app structure with unit/, integration/, e2e/ subdirs. alembic/ for database migrations. data/certificates/ for generated PDFs (gitignored). Docker files at root.
